description: This is a Flutter widget implementing a note editing screen, including functionality for viewing, editing, saving, and deleting notes. It also integrates with a synchronization engine to keep data consistent.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget for editing a note, including UI elements for title and content, and buttons for saving or deleting the note. It manages state using Riverpod and handles navigation.

classes.name: _NoteEditorScreenState
classes.description: State class for NoteEditorScreen managing the controllers, save/delete logic, and UI build method.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves the current note data to repository and triggers synchronization.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note from repository and triggers synchronization.
